title: Ukraine submits Black Sea ceasefire offer, awaits Russian response
summary: ⁠Ukraine ​made a Black Sea ceasefire offer ​to enable food exports and passed the details on to international allies, a senior Ukrainian official said Friday, adding that Kyiv was waiting for a response from Moscow.
